meta.title: SLATE grocery research, part five: staples from the same brands
meta.supplements: research-groceries.json, research-groceries2.json, research-groceries3.json, research-groceries4.json (same product schema). This file adds products only; it repeats no product already in those files.
meta.method: Read product by product on 2026-10-05, searching each brand on the chain's own storefront. Price Rite (store 301, Hamden CT), The Fresh Grocer (store 197) and Smart & Final (store 371) answered search pages at www.<chain>.com/sm/.../rsid/<id>/results?q=<brand>, each returning a window.__PRELOADED_STATE__ JSON blob with live prices and UPCs parsed directly from the page; confirmed:true. SuperValu Ireland (store 5550) answered the same way at shop.supervalu.ie; confirmed:true. Chedraui (Mexico) answered its own VTEX catalogue API directly, https://www.chedraui.com.mx/api/catalog_system/pub/products/search/<brand>?map=ft, returning product name, EAN and price as JSON; confirmed:true. Giant Tiger (Canada) answered its own Shopify predictive-search endpoint, https://www.gianttiger.com/search/suggest.json?q=<brand>&resources[type]=product, returning live JSON prices in CAD; confirmed:true (an improvement on the client-rendered product pages that blocked this same chain in part four). Tesco and Sainsbury's continue to block automated reads of tesco.com and sainsburys.co.uk directly (HTTP 403, confirmed again this session); those rows were read instead from Trolley.co.uk, a third-party UK price-comparison tracker, by fetching each product's own Trolley page (not its search-aggregate page, which does not label retailers) and reading the per-retailer price table on it; confirmed:false, with the retailer named in the note. Save-On-Foods (saveonfoods.com) again returned HTTP 403 on every request this session; no rows for it are included. Where a product was on promotion (isDiscounted/wasPrice on a Wynshop or SuperValu storefront), the regular (non-promotional) price is recorded and the promotional price is given in the note.

fieldNotes.sizeQty: Converted to g or ml (1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 lb = 453.592 g, 1 US fl oz = 29.5735 ml), rounded to the nearest unit. For counted packs (pittas, bagels, sandwich thins, biscuits) where only a count was given, sizeQty is the count and sizeUnit is 'ct'. For multipacks with a stated per-unit weight (Danone Activia/Actimel, Yoplait 4-pack), sizeQty is the total weight across the pack and size is shown in kg/g/ml/L as the chain's own feed gave the total.
fieldNotes.pricedBy: 'each' = price for the stated pack or item.
fieldNotes.taxIncluded: false for US and CA, where food for home consumption is generally untaxed or zero-rated; true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include VAT/IVA.
fieldNotes.brand: Set to the specific trademark on the pack (e.g. 'Danone' only where the pack itself reads 'Danone ...', as with Activia and Actimel at SuperValu; 'Cheerios' for the cereal's own box name even where General Mills is the maker).

gaps: US: Price Rite, The Fresh Grocer and Smart & Final between them covered every US brand sought in this file's final selection. Filippo Berio, Gold Medal, King Arthur, Bertolli and Domino were also found at smartfinal/thefreshgrocer (see the brandsSought list) but were left out of this file's 133 products to keep the set to a well-verified size; they were not dropped for lack of data.

CA: Save-On-Foods returned HTTP 403 on every request this session, as in parts three and four; no saveonfoods rows are included anywhere in this file. Giant Tiger's predictive-search API had no matches for Goya, Skippy, Smucker's, Tillamook, Cabot or Tate & Lyle under those brand names (it returned unrelated products, mostly clothing and unrelated snacks), so those brands have no Canadian row.

GB: Tesco and Sainsbury's rows are all confirmed:false, read via Trolley.co.uk per product because the retailers' own sites block automated reads. Lurpak, Warburtons, Hovis, Cathedral City and Weetabix are GB/IE-market butter, bread and cereal brands not stocked by Chedraui, Giant Tiger or the US Wynshop chains, so they have no US/CA/MX rows in this file.
IE: SuperValu Ireland does not carry Tillamook, Cabot, Goya, Chobani (as such), Skippy, Jif, Smucker's, Gold Medal, King Arthur or Filippo Berio under those names, so those brands have no Irish row.

MX: Chedraui's catalogue search returned no good match for Lurpak, Warburtons, Hovis, Cathedral City, Avonmore, Brennans, Flahavan's, Kerrygold, Cabot, Tillamook, Smucker's or Tate & Lyle, so those brands have no Mexican row. Chedraui is read without a delivery address, so prices are the site's default seller price; branch prices in Mexico City can differ.

Lactalis/Président, Uncle Ben's/Ben's Original, La Costeña, Bimbo, Lala, Alpura and Sello Rojo were all searched this session (Giant Tiger returned several Ben's Original Bistro Express rice side dishes; Chedraui returned Bimbo, Lala, Alpura and Sello Rojo staples) but are not included in this file's final 133-product selection, which stopped at 27 brands once each had 4-8 well-verified rows across at least one market; none was dropped for lack of data, and Président specifically was not found at any of the nine chains searched this session.

All markets: prices are one day's reading (2026-10-05); store-level prices vary, and Wynshop/SuperValu promotional prices in particular can change daily. Where isDiscounted was true, the regular (non-promotional) price is what is recorded, per the house honesty rule, with the promotional price given in the note.
